scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.test:staging-rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.staging-test.json --only database --project demo-qlist "node --test --test-timeout=20000 test/staging-rules.integration.ts"
scripts.test:candidate-rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.candidate-test.json --only database --project demo-qlist "node --test --test-timeout=60000 test/candidate-rules.integration.ts"
scripts.build:release: node scripts/build-release.mjs modern && node scripts/build-release.mjs maintenance && node scripts/build-release.mjs rollback
scripts.test:migration: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.candidate-test.json --only database --project demo-qlist "node --test --test-timeout=60000 test/migration.integration.ts"
scripts.test:release-ui: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.candidate-test.json --only database --project demo-qlist "node --test --test-timeout=60000 test/release-ui.integration.ts"
